og.alt: Motion (@pyreon/kinetic + kinetic-presets): A presence animation is one line. The compositor runs it.

hero.alt: Code: const FadeUp = kinetic('div').preset(fadeUp), used as <FadeUp show={() => open()}>. When open() turns true a card fades and slides up into a list; later it fades out before unmounting. A timeline underneath shows the main thread doing two small steps (apply styles across a double requestAnimationFrame, then transitionend) while the compositor runs the transform and opacity transition.
